title: Vegan Dutch Stew
description: A hearty and comforting vegan stew made with tender potatoes and a rich, peppery broth.
instructions: Heat the stew over medium heat in a large pot.
Add the vegan broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add diced potatoes and cook for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until they're tender.
Stir in the peppery and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Let the stew rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Enjoy your delicious vegan Dutch stew!
